title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the reception, conversion and transmission or regeneration of voice, images or other data, including switching and routing apparatus

candidates.rationale: The HS6 subheading 851762 covers the same conversion and regeneration function, but it lacks the EU national line for France.

title.en: Communication apparatus (excluding telephone sets or base stations); machines for the transmission or reception of voice, images or other data (including wired/wireless networks), n.e.c. in item no. 8517.6

candidates.rationale: The residual subheading 851769 covers other data transmission apparatus n.e.c. and could apply if the dock were not treated as a conversion device.
candidates.set_aside_reason: The dock's signal conversion and network function fits the specific 851762 subheading better than this residual one.
